[[File:Players Committee 20th anniversary logo.jpg|right|200px|alt=PC20 logo: a green 20 over a Yoda silhouette above the SWCCG Players Committee box mark]]
'''Players Committee marketing''' covers the promotional work of the [[Players Committee]] (PC): its anniversary and yearly logos, branded deckboxes, giveaways and prize programs, and the advertisements it publishes for events. The work falls to the PC's marketing and communications team, led by the [[Marketing Advocate]], whose remit includes social media, prize support, streaming, outreach and the annual Donations Program.<ref name="oc2024">PC organization chart PDF (PDF creation date 6 May 2024), [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261010210152/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> [[Jared Napolitano]] has been Marketing Advocate since March 2021.<ref name="mkt2021">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/new-marketing-advocate-introduction/ New Marketing Advocate Introduction], starwarsccg.org (14 March 2021). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022040440/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/new-marketing-advocate-introduction.html Internet Archive]</ref> Most of the items below were offered as rewards in the Donations Program or as tournament and stream prizes rather than sold.

== Logos ==

The PC marked its 20th anniversary with the '''PC20''' logo, a green "20" over a silhouette of Yoda above the SWCCG Players Committee box mark. The @swccg account adopted it as its avatar on 3 January 2022, announcing that the PC would celebrate its 20th anniversary in April.<ref name="x-avatar">[https://x.com/swccg/status/1478070880676818950 "New avatar as we enter 2022!"], @swccg on X (3 January 2022). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123011900/https://swccg.com/snapshots/x/1478070880676818950.html Internet Archive]</ref> The PC turned 20 on 30 April 2022 and celebrated with the [[2022 PC20 Tournament]] on [[GEMP]] that day.<ref name="pc20wrap">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/pc20-anniversary-tournament-wrap-strother-victorious/ PC20 Anniversary Tournament Wrap - Strother Victorious], starwarsccg.org (10 May 2022). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022203611/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/pc20-anniversary-tournament-wrap-strother-victorious.html Internet Archive]</ref> The same mark was printed on PC20 sleeves and on the Challenge 2022 booster packs (see below).

Yearly logos followed the same layout, with a droid in place of Yoda: a blue R2-D2 logo for 2023 and an orange BB-8 logo for 2024 carrying the address SWCCG.ORG. Both appear in the gallery below. Earlier logos are covered in [[Players Committee#Logo history]].

== Deckboxes ==

=== PC XL Series 1 (Next Generation deckboxes) ===

The Next Generation deckboxes were Series 1 of the PC XL deckboxes.<ref name="bisco20261123">Personal communication from [[Bill Bisco]], 23 November 2026.</ref> The 2021 Donations Program helped pay for them.<ref name="don2022">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=79611 2022 Donations Program], post by Jnapolit31 ([[Jared Napolitano]]), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums (19 November 2021). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123011459/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t79611.html Internet Archive]</ref> In the 2022 Donations Program (15 December 2021 &ndash; 15 April 2022), donors at Tier 3 ($100&ndash;$199) could pick one of six designs.<ref name="don2022" /> The six boxes show Admiral Ackbar, an AT-AT, Kylo Ren, Luke Skywalker, Rey and Ahsoka Tano, each with the SWCCG Players Committee box mark in gold. Some boxes print an image credit: the Rey box reads "Image courtesy of JokerLolibel Cosplay" and the Ahsoka box "Image courtesy of Eleonora Scanu".

=== PC XL Series 2 and prizes ===

Series 2 of the PC XL deckboxes was previewed from late October 2022, when @swccg posted a Dark Side box and said details on how to get them would follow.<ref name="x-s2spoil">[https://x.com/swccg/status/1585458764567793665 "The Dark Side of the Force is strong with this deckbox!"], @swccg on X (27 October 2022). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123011954/https://swccg.com/snapshots/x/1585458764567793665.html Internet Archive]</ref> The 2023 Donations Program, announced on 5 November 2022, carried the PC XL deckboxes over from the 2022 program with a fresh set of designs, Series 2, following the Series 1 Next Generation boxes,<ref name="bisco20261123" /> and let donors choose more than one box; the PC planned to give deckboxes out only through the program that year.<ref name="don2023">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2023-pc-donations-program-to-commence-november-15/ 2023 PC Donations Program to Commence November 15!], starwarsccg.org (5 November 2022). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123011728/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2023-pc-donations-program-to-commence-november-15.html Internet Archive]</ref> It opened on 15 November 2022,<ref name="x-don2023open">[https://x.com/swccg/status/1592532887122825217 "The #SWCCG PC Donations program is open!"], @swccg on X (15 November 2022). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123012023/https://swccg.com/snapshots/x/1592532887122825217.html Internet Archive]</ref> and ran until 15 March 2023; the PC called it the only chance to get a Series 2 box.<ref name="x-don2023end">[https://x.com/swccg/status/1630222302402039810 "Reminder: The 2023 #SWCCG Donations Program is open only until March 15th"], @swccg on X (27 February 2023). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123012211/https://swccg.com/snapshots/x/1630222302402039810.html Internet Archive]</ref> One Series 2 box features Thrawn.<ref name="x-thrawn">[https://x.com/swccg/status/1611154055161864192 "One of our favorite characters, which is why he's featured on one of the Series 2 deckboxes."], @swccg on X (6 January 2023). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123012051/https://swccg.com/snapshots/x/1611154055161864192.html Internet Archive]</ref> Its teaser image reads "A Great Tactician Creates <s>Plans</s> Decks" and "Follow @swccg on Twitter for imminent details on Series 2 of the PC's XL Deckboxes"; the box credits "William Jay & Maeden Photography".

XL deckboxes were also given away and used as prizes. On 4 May 2023 a PC20 XL deckbox was given away on a special episode of [[Holotheatre]].<ref name="x-may4">[https://x.com/swccg/status/1654154670493913088 "In honor of May The Fourth"], @swccg on X (4 May 2023). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123012312/https://swccg.com/snapshots/x/1654154670493913088.html Internet Archive]</ref> The events of the 2023 GEMP Thematic Swiss Series, such as [[Grievous' Gambit]], awarded "PC XL Deckboxes corresponding to Event Character". At Event 4, Skirmish for Sidious, held on 7 October 2023 as a chance to play the new [[Virtual Set 22]] cards, three players won the Palpatine box.<ref name="sidious">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=82862 EVENT #4: Skirmish for Sidious - October 7th (2023 GEMP Thematic Swiss Series)], post by Jnapolit31 ([[Jared Napolitano]]), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums (5 May 2023, updated with results). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123011602/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t82862.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="x-sidious">[https://x.com/swccg/status/1709275050132541867 "Looking to test out the newest V-Set 22 cards?"], @swccg on X (3 October 2023). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123012409/https://swccg.com/snapshots/x/1709275050132541867.html Internet Archive]</ref>

=== Darksaber anthology box ===

The 2024 Donations Program opened on 15 December 2023<ref name="x-don2024open">[https://x.com/swccg/status/1735732881408872533 "The #SWCCG PC Donations program is open for 2024!"], @swccg on X (15 December 2023). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123012518/https://swccg.com/snapshots/x/1735732881408872533.html Internet Archive]</ref> and ran until 31 March 2024. Donors at Tier 2 or above received a black SWCCG Players Committee storage box printed with a Darksaber.<ref name="x-darksaber">[https://x.com/swccg/status/1767206563880538193 "Reminder that the 2024 #SWCCG PC Donations program ends March 31st!"], @swccg on X (11 March 2024). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123012548/https://swccg.com/snapshots/x/1767206563880538193.html Internet Archive]</ref> Its advertisement shows it beside [[First Anthology]], [[Second Anthology]] and [[Third Anthology]] boxes under the headline "The Darksaber is a more noble <s>weapon</s> anthology box for you to wield", and closes "Add or upgrade a fine addition to your Star Wars CCG storage collection today!"

== Giveaways and prize programs ==

=== Best Virtual Card Image Challenge and sticker book (2022) ===

In early 2022 players voted, match by match in the Star Wars CCG Facebook group and on Challonge, on the best of 64 full-art virtual card images. To mark the challenge in the PC's 20th anniversary year, the PC, chiefly graphics designer [[Kevin Jaap]], made a sticker album of the 64 images. The stickers came in sealed booster packs, labelled "Best Virtual Card Image Challenge 2022 – Booster Pack" and "Free giveaway – not for sale", together with special foil cards on a unique foil paper. Packs could be earned only by watching PC streams on Twitch (Holotheatre, GEMP coverage and live event coverage) and emailing the card "token" named on the stream. [[Dan Tartaglione]] announced the program on 5 February 2022.<ref name="sticker">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=80116 2022 Best Virtual Card Image Sticker Book Prize Program!], post by DTartagOne ([[Dan Tartaglione]]), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums (5 February 2022). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123011528/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t80116.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="x-sticker">[https://twitter.com/swccg/status/1490734471947116556 "How about collecting v-card stickers for listening to SWCCG Twitch streams?"], @swccg on Twitter (7 February 2022). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20220207171651/https://twitter.com/swccg/status/1490734471947116556 Internet Archive]</ref> Kevin Jaap showed 357 boosters from the first batch in April 2022, and in February 2023 the Marketing Advocate listed the players still owed packs, about 800 in all.<ref name="sticker" />

=== PC20 sleeves ===

The 2022 Donations Program's Tier 4 ($200&ndash;$399) included 120 "Star Wars CCG PC 20th Anniversary" sleeves, one set for Light Side cards and one for Dark Side cards.<ref name="don2022" /> The 2023 program offered PC20 sleeves again, 60 for each side, at Tiers 3 and 4.<ref name="don2023" /> The sleeves, black and clear, are embossed "20th Anniversary / SWCCG Players Committee / Established 2002". A set was also a random prize at the [[2022 PC20 Tournament]].

=== 2022 Player Survey and GEMP giveaway ===

On 21 October 2022 the Players Committee launched a player survey offering an [[Anakin Skywalker, Padawan Learner]] virtual slip for submissions by 16 November; after updating the survey on 24 October, the deadline was moved to 7 November 2022 for a foil [[Anakin Skywalker, Padawan Learner]] virtual slip.<ref name="slack-survey22">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Jared Napolitano (JaredNap) and James Martin (solidsnck) / Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 21 and 24 October 2022: “Submit the survey by November 16th and you'll be awarded an Anakin Skywalker, Padawan Learner V-Slip!” / “Submit the survey by November 7th and you'll be awarded an Anakin Skywalker, Padawan Learner foil V-Slip!”</ref> To mark [[Virtual Set 20]] and the PC's 20th anniversary on 12 December 2022, every player who played a [[GEMP]] game in 2022 was awarded a digital [[Luke Skywalker]] AI card on GEMP.<ref name="slack-luke22">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Garrett Larson (deadbody) / Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 12 December 2022: “as a thank you to all who played a GEMP game in 2022, you'll be receiving a digital Luke Skywalker AI on GEMP!”</ref>

=== 2023 Online Play Week and Donations Programs ===

The 2023 Online Play Week ran from 17–26 February 2023 across [[GEMP]] and [[Holotable]] with foil prizes and drew 96 submissions.<ref name="slack-opw23">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Jared Napolitano (JaredNap) / Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg) and James Martin (solidsnck), 8, 17, and 20 March 2023: “2023-online-play-week-slated-for-february-17-26” / “The PC had 96 (ninety six!) Online Play Week submissions.”</ref> The 2023 Donations Program closed early on 15 March 2023 to ship Series 2 PC XL deckboxes sooner.<ref name="slack-don23-close">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Scott Lingrell (Scott) / Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 27 February 2023: “The 2023 #SWCCG Donations Program is open only until March 15th in an effort to get rewards to donors sooner! This will be your only chance to snag Series 2 PC XL Deckboxes.”</ref> The 2024 Donations Program was introduced via stream on 1 December 2023; by 20 December 2023 the Ahsoka deckbox, black winter hats, and Defensive Shield sleeves (25 Light Side / 25 Dark Side, $300+ tiers) were down to limited remaining stock.<ref name="slack-don24-dec">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Jared Napolitano (JaredNap), 1 and 20 December 2023: “2024 PC Donations Program - Announcement Stream” / “limited availability left: Ahsoka deckbox (eligible to all tiers), Black winter hats (eligible to all tiers), Defensive Shield sleeves set (25 LS/25 DS) (eligible to $300+ tiers)”.</ref>

=== Play Star Wars CCG in Public Week (2023) ===

"Play Star Wars CCG in Public Week" ran from Saturday 22 April to Sunday 30 April 2023. Players were asked to play a game at a comic shop, café, bar or other public space and post a photo with the hashtag #SWCCGinPublic or email it to the PC; everyone who emailed a photo received a foil [[Mustafar: Private Platform (Docking Bay)]] slip. Local events held in the window also counted.<ref name="public-forum">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=82693 Play Star Wars CCG in Public Week (Apr 22-30)], post by Solidsnack3, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums (6 April 2023). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026200632/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t82693.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="x-public">[https://x.com/swccg/status/1644398121818914817 "“Play Star Wars CCG in Public Week” is upcoming"], @swccg on X (7 April 2023). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123012245/https://swccg.com/snapshots/x/1644398121818914817.html Internet Archive]</ref> The PC's recap counted 99 players.<ref name="public-recap">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/the-first-swccginpublic-push-was-a-rousing-success/ The First #SWCCGinPublic Push Was a Rousing Success], starwarsccg.org (19 May 2023). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027103740/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/the-first-swccginpublic-push-was-a-rousing-success.html Internet Archive]</ref> See [[SWCCGinPublic]].

=== 2023 World Championship ===

Players who pre-registered for the [[2023 World Championship]] in Morristown, New Jersey received foil cards and a PC cooler bag; pre-registration closed on 21 July 2023.<ref name="x-cooler">[https://x.com/swccg/status/1682448882519756808 "Today is the final day to pre-register for the 2023 World Championship"], @swccg on X (21 July 2023). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123012340/https://swccg.com/snapshots/x/1682448882519756808.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Event advertising ==

The PC marked the 25th anniversary of ''[[The Phantom Menace]]'' with GEMP leagues from 25 April to 19 May 2024: a Retro event in the [[Premiere - Tatooine]] format and an Open "Achievement Scavenger Hunt".<ref name="tpm25">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewforum.php?f=1507 The Phantom Menace: 25th Anniversary Events presented by the SWCCG PC], Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums (forum section, April&ndash;May 2024). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123011430/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/f1507.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="x-tpm25a">[https://x.com/swccg/status/1780323663587266577 "It's been nearly 25 years since The Phantom Menace came out?"], @swccg on X (16 April 2024). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123012618/https://swccg.com/snapshots/x/1780323663587266577.html Internet Archive]</ref> Its poster, a pencil drawing of Jar Jar Binks credited "Image courtesy of yakutsk", reads "Darth Jar Jar commands you to participate in the Phantom Menace 25th Anniversary Leagues!" @swccg posted it on 30 April 2024.<ref name="x-tpm25b">[https://x.com/swccg/status/1785312824832483809 "Darth Jar Jar wants you to join #SWCCG GEMP leagues"], @swccg on X (30 April 2024). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123012646/https://swccg.com/snapshots/x/1785312824832483809.html Internet Archive]</ref>

=== 2024 Donations Program and Series 4 items ===
Following the 31 March 2024 close of the 2024 Donations Program window, [[Jared Napolitano]] announced on 9 April 2024 that remaining incentive stock was still available.<ref name="slack-don24-ext">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, [[Jared Napolitano]] (JaredNap), 9 April 2024: “If you found out about the 2024 PC Donations Program after the window "closed" on March 31, fear not. There is some stock still for the incentives offered.”</ref> On 5 September 2024, Series 4 GEMP Alternate Image Booster Packs went on sale in the GEMP Merchant, and on 24 September 2024 Napolitano announced that Series 4 poker chips (“FOR LUCK”) had arrived.<ref name="slack-s4-2024">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, [[Jared Napolitano]] (JaredNap), 5 September 2024 (“Series 4 GEMP Alternate Image Booster Packs are now available for purchase in the GEMP Merchant”) and 24 September 2024 (“Series 4 poker chips have arrived! “FOR LUCK””).</ref>

=== 2025–2026 alternate-image PDFs, Community Cards, and Donations Programs ===
On 30 January 2025, the PC published its 2025 official alternate-image PDF (<code>Official_Alternate_Images_2025.pdf</code>), also made available through VKit.<ref name="slack-ai25">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, "darkjediknight11", 30 January 2025: “The official AI PDF update for 2025 is now live! Head over to the PC page for the PDF and start using some cool newly available AI images! Also available on VKit!”</ref> On 13 March 2025, the PC announced Community Award Cards in PC Booster Packs starting April 2025—debuting at Talaga Vegas Nights in Las Vegas—and on 5 April 2025 announced the 2024 Advocate Awards and their Community Cards.<ref name="slack-cac25">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, [[Scott Lingrell]] (Scott), 13 March 2025 (“Starting April 2025, Community Award Cards are coming—celebrating the legends of the game! Find them in PC Booster Packs at major events” / “First event to get the Community cards and booster packs - Talaga Vegas Nights in Las Vegas”) and 5 April 2025 (“The 2024 Advocate Awards have officially been announced! ... Check out the new Advocate Award Community Cards”).</ref>

The 2025 Donations Program was announced on 9 September 2025, with a 30 November order cutoff for playmats and Tier 1–2 inventory remaining open after the cutoff.<ref name="slack-don25">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, [[Jared Napolitano]] (JaredNap), 9 September 2025 (“2025 PC Donations Program announcement”), 16 November 2025 (“donate on or before Nov. 30”), and 18 December 2025 (“Even though we are past the November 30 announced "cutoff", you may still donate to the PC and get all of the incentives... The only exception would be the playmats”).</ref> On 4 January 2026, Napolitano reported that playmats had arrived, that top-tier demand prompted a fresh “Series 3” batch of blue-and-gray-mesh PC trucker flex-fit hats matching the Anakin's saber anthology box, and that Tier 4 donors could still submit custom nine-slip sheets.<ref name="slack-don26-jan">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, [[Jared Napolitano]] (JaredNap), 4 January 2026: “1) playmats have been ordered and received... 2) due to the demand for the top tier, I ordered a fresh batch of PC trucker flex fit hats- a Series 3 if you will... Blue to match the Anakin’s saber anthology box (gray mesh). 3) there are a number of tier 4 donors who never submitted their custom 9 slip sheet.”</ref>

Meanwhile, on 17 October 2025, [[Karl Koenig]] was announced as the PC's new [[Marketing Advocate]].<ref name="slack-mkt-ka">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, "darkjediknight11", 17 October 2025: “The Advocates are excited to announce our newest Marketing Advocate, none other than Karl Koenig!”</ref> For the [[2026 Boston Winter Classic]], Koenig announced on 19 December 2025 that pre-registration included a foil borderless [[Ezra Bridger]] card designed by [[Mike Gemme]].<ref name="slack-bwc26-ezra">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, [[Karl Koenig]] (KrazyKarl), 19 December 2025: “the incentive for pre-registration will be a foil borderless Ezra Bridger, a player designed card from a Boston local KTOD legend Mike Gemme!”</ref> On 10 February 2026, the PC announced Series Three Community Cards honoring 2025 Advocate Award winners and contributors (included in 2026 League Kits, major events, and Regional/State prize kits, with a reveal stream on 2 March 2026).<ref name="slack-cac26">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, [[Scott Lingrell]] (Scott), 10 February 2026: “The Players Committee is releasing a new wave of Series Three Community Cards to recognize key contributors and Advocate Award winners from 2025. These will continue the Community Card tradition and will be included in PC Booster Packs for 2026 League Kits, major events, and Regional/State prize kits.” / “Live reveal stream: Monday, March 2 — 8 PM EST”.</ref> On 2 April 2026, Koenig announced that due to a printing error on the 2026 Donation event vouchers, the PC would honor them until 30 April 2027.<ref name="slack-voucher26">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, [[Karl Koenig]] (KrazyKarl), 2 April 2026: “Also, there was a printing error with this years Donation event vouchers (bad new Marketing Advocate). The PC will honor the event vouchers you receive until April 30, 2027”.</ref>
